caption: The drawing depicts a single straw bonnet in a three-quarter view, predominantly colored in light shades of yellow and tan with a textured pattern representing woven straw. The bonnet has a pale, off-white inner lining, and a large, soft, cream-colored ribbon or piece of fabric drapes from its lower back edge, extending downward and curling onto the surface. On the left side of the drawing, there is a simple, unfinished pencil sketch of the same bonnet, showing its outline and basic structure with minimal detail. The background is plain and uncolored, and the entire composition is centered around the detailed depiction of the bonnet.
title: Shaker Bonnet
